title: The Gaze Ethic — From Observer to Stewardship
status: recovered ethical formulation + mature public ethic
purpose: Give the Eye/Observer/Still-Center architecture an ethical criterion: seeing is not sufficient; perception should improve conditions rather than merely demand recognition or obedience.

core_question.formulation: Is my gaze making the world better, or am I merely demanding that the world become better for me?

functional_chain: Eye → perception → discernment → evaluation → choice → intervention/withholding → consequences → stewardship
problem_it_solves: Without an ethic, Observer/Throne/Center can become pure self-reference. The gaze question tests whether centrality produces repair or merely asks the world to confirm the center.

mature_public_alignment.relation: The gaze question supplies the upstream decision rule; the public stewardship maxims supply downstream action rules.

tests.name: Protection test
tests.question: Does the decision reduce avoidable harm to vulnerable life?

tests.name: Understanding test
tests.question: Does information improve comprehension rather than merely increase possession/status?

tests.name: Building test
tests.question: Does accumulated resource create durable capacity rather than extraction?

tests.name: Service test
tests.question: Does authority increase others' ability to live/grow independently?

tests.name: Reversibility test
tests.question: Would the same rule remain acceptable if applied to the observer?

tests.name: Evidence test
tests.question: Does the observer update when evidence contradicts the preferred interpretation?

relation_to_gardener: Gardener is the practical form of the ethical gaze: observe soil/seed/conditions, intervene only where useful, prune damaging growth, nourish viable growth, and judge success by what can flourish independently afterward.
relation_to_thomas: Thomas/questioning prevents Eye from becoming infallible by role. A system that sees also needs a function that tests what it thinks it sees.
relation_to_archive: Archive weighting is an institutionalized gaze ethic: preserve sources, distinguish provenance, surface counterevidence, avoid overwriting old states, and let readers inspect how conclusions were reached.
relation_to_farm: Farm can also watch intensely, but uses observation for extraction/containment. Garden uses observation for cultivation. Therefore surveillance intensity alone cannot distinguish them; objective function does.
deep_findings: The ethical opposite of blindness is not omniscience but accountable seeing.
The Eye becomes useful only when coupled to Door/choice and Gardener/service.
A 'still center' that never updates risks becoming narrative lock-in; Thomas/test and provenance provide movement without destroying stillness.
The project's mature ethics can be represented as a control loop: see accurately → choose proportionately → act for protection/building → observe consequences → revise.
